verdict.rationale: Parsec's download page lists clients for Windows, macOS, Linux (Ubuntu 22.04), Android and Chrome web, which covers major desktop platforms plus one mobile platform. Hosting is documented only for Windows 10+ and macOS 10.15+, so mixed-OS pairings such as a Windows host with a macOS, Linux or Android viewer are implied by this split rather than stated outright. missing for 10: iOS/iPadOS client, Linux hosting, explicit documentation of cross-OS host/viewer interoperability, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform sessions.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
